# Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog

## SYNOPSIS

Empties the log buffer of a running active proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog [-Name] <string> [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog cmdlet deletes every entry the active proxy session named in -Name keeps in its log buffer, so the next Get-ZbxActiveProxyLog shows only what happens from now on. The session keeps running and logging. -WhatIf shows which session it would clear. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Start the log afresh

```powershell
Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog -Name 'uplink'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
Get-ZbxActiveProxyLog -Name 'uplink' | Select-Object Timestamp, Message
```

After the clear, the log holds only the pulls and uploads that follow.
